(async()=>{
  const until=async predicate=>{let deadline=Date.now()+7000;while(!predicate()){if(Date.now()>deadline)throw Error('Complete flow timed out: '+document.getElementById('status').textContent);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,25));}};
  const assert=(value,message)=>{if(!value)throw Error(message)};
  await until(()=>document.getElementById('planTitle').textContent==='Split screen, drawn by hand' && !document.getElementById('execute').disabled);
  assert(document.getElementById('sourceBadge').textContent==='DESKTOP + AI','Desktop source label missing');
  assert(document.getElementById('captureTargets').querySelectorAll('rect').length===2,'Both proposed window regions should be visible');
  document.getElementById('reviewCapture').click();
  assert(document.getElementById('captureReview').open,'Desktop review should open');
  document.getElementById('closeCaptureReview').click();
  document.getElementById('execute').click();
  await until(()=>document.getElementById('planBadge').textContent==='REHEARSAL COMPLETE' && !document.getElementById('execute').disabled);
  assert(document.getElementById('runCount').textContent==='0','Rehearsal must not execute real window arrangements');
  const select=document.querySelector('[data-app-select="0"]');
  select.value='messages';select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  await until(()=>document.getElementById('sourceBadge').textContent==='APP CORRECTED BY YOU'&&!document.getElementById('execute').disabled);
  const corrected=await window.doodle.pendingPlan();
  assert(JSON.parse(corrected.actions[0].value).app==='messages','Corrected app must reach executable plan');
  assert(JSON.parse(corrected.actions[0].value).width===500,'Correction must retain window bounds');
  assert(!document.getElementById('editPlan').hidden&&!document.getElementById('retryPlan').disabled,'Recovery controls should remain available');
  return {doneToInterpretation:true,splitScreenPlan:true,markedReview:true,rehearsal:true,liveApi:false,desktopMutated:false};
})()
